instruction: Set the slide dimensions to 12 inches wide by 6 inches tall for a wide banner format.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting custom wide banner format (12 x 6 inches = 10972800 x 5486400 EMU, 2:1 ratio). Similar to other custom size tasks.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both slide width (12 inches) and height (6 inches) requirements from the instruction
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter - directly accesses 'width_inches' and 'height_inches' from the rules dictionary (expected_state IS the rules dict when type='rule')
Getter (vm_file) correctly extracts the PowerPoint file after postconfig saves it
Metric logic is semantically correct: opens PowerPoint file, extracts slide dimensions, converts expected inches to EMU (914400 EMU per inch), compares with 1% tolerance
Expected values (12 x 6 inches) are semantically correct for the wide banner format instruction
Edge case handling: includes error handling and tolerance for dimension comparison
Complete coverage: verifies all instruction requirements (width AND height)
